questions: Should the radial ticks be placed at the specified position (index*45 degrees) only when a function is plotted, or also when no function is specified (the prompt says 'or evenly spaced if no function is specified' but the function always takes a func_index)?
What is the radial range (rmin, rmax) for the polar plot? Should it be automatically scaled to fit the function values, or set to a fixed range?
Should the plot include a grid, and if so, with what style (e.g., radial and angular grid lines)?
Is the function expected to clear any existing content on the axes before plotting, or overlay the new plot on top?
Should the function set the angular domain explicitly (e.g., via set_thetamin/max) even though the clarification says 0 to 2π, or rely on default polar axes behavior?
What should happen if func_index is negative? Should it be treated as a valid index (e.g., -1 for last function) or raise an error?
Should the function set any title or labels (e.g., r'$\sin(\theta)$') on the plot?
How many points should be used for plotting? The reference uses 1000, but is that a requirement or can implementations choose a different number?
